title: Minnesota lawyer suspended over fake AI case citations

reading.body:
The underlying article text was not captured in the source data, so the specific facts of this incident, including which AI system was used, what citations were fabricated, and the precise grounds for suspension, are not established here.

The title alone indicates that a lawyer in Minnesota was suspended in connection with submitting fake case citations attributed to AI output. This matches a documented failure mode in which a generative AI system produces plausible-looking but fictitious legal citations, and a user submits them to a court without independent verification. That failure happens at the point of human use, after the model has already generated its output, and it would have been caught by checking each citation against an actual legal database before filing.

Whether the suspension was the result of a court ruling, a bar disciplinary proceeding, or some other action is not established by the available information.
